annotation.evidence_span: When wrapping the sequence field, the server MUST ensure that a value with the same sequence has been received and acknowledged by the client.
annotation.interpretation_a: The server must ensure that the client has received and acknowledged a value with the same sequence number as the one being wrapped (i.e., the new sequence number after wrap).
annotation.interpretation_b: The server must ensure that the client has received and acknowledged a value with the same sequence number as the one that was previously used (i.e., the previous sequence number before wrap).
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a clear constraint on which sequence number must be acknowledged, allowing two materially different interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: Which sequence number is referred to by 'the same sequence' in the clause? The clause does not specify whether it refers to the new wrapped value or the previous value, leading to ambiguity in implementation requirements.
